svg.text: Artificial respiratory asynchrony: same rate, drifting phase between belts
Formula from modify_data_to_test.m: lungs = sin(12 bpm), diaphragm = 0.85*sin(12 bpm + phase_drift)
Default fake interval is 480-600 s, shown here as local time 0-120 s.
maximum offset ~149 deg (~2.1 s at 12 bpm)
3) Middle: phase shift is visible when overlaid
4) Full raw-style view: visible mainly as peak shift, but dense
5) Belt-vs-belt view: phase drift changes the loop
Takeaway: in separate raw belt panels the asynchrony can be hard to see across the full 120 s; in zoomed overlay or belt-vs-belt plots it is clear.
